scope: Independent PWA served locally at http://127.0.0.1:8787/recording.html, desktop Chrome 157 on Windows, tiny q8 model. NOT an iPad/iPhone test.
finding_1_url_failure: Nothing was listening on port 8787 (curl returned 000). The URL only worked while a test agent had run `python -m http.server` by hand. Fix: scripts/serve_pwa.py + 開啟本機網頁版.cmd.
finding_2_v4_hang: v4 awaited audioContext.resume() before getUserMedia, with no timeout. A suspended AudioContext never resolves resume() without user activation (measured: still pending after 3 s, state 'suspended'); a scripted click left the page stuck at starting=true with every control disabled. With a genuine click in desktop Chrome v4 did record. Whether real iPad Safari hits this is unverified.
finding_3_stale_cache: After rebuilding, Chrome kept serving the v4 HTML (python http.server sends no Cache-Control). serve_pwa.py sends Cache-Control: no-cache for HTML, sw.js and manifests.
v5_changes: recording no longer creates or awaits an AudioContext; getUserMedia has a 60 s timeout
decoding uses OfflineAudioContext at 16 kHz (fallback 44.1 kHz) with a 30 s timeout
